basic_info.description: Located in vibrant Lower Nob Hill, this striking one-bed, two-bath loft condo offers a blend of modern sophistication and exceptional value. The expansive open-concept living/dining area is framed by a dramatic wall of French doors, skylights and soaring windows, bathing the space in natural light to create an airy ambiance. A sleek fireplace adds warmth to this refined urban retreat. The kitchen features granite counters, stainless appliances, and generous cabinet space. A full bath and laundry closet complete the main level. Ascend to the mezzanine bedroom, where skylights invite the morning sun and a private balcony offers a tranquil escape. The ensuite second bath enhances privacy and comfort.  Residents enjoy access to a spacious common-area patio, an inviting venue for weekend BBQs and social gatherings. Additional amenities include one onsite parking, storage cage, Webpass internet, and Swiftlane video entry system. With a downtown location steps from shopping, restaurants, and cultural landmarks, this condo offers easy access to Civic Center, Hayes Valley, Union Square, Market St, Van Ness/101, MUNI, and BART. Whether you're seeking a stylish pied-a-terre, or full-time residence, this home delivers a balance of comfort, convenience, and cosmopolitan flair.
